decisions.reason: The source explicitly changes only Big Block prize parameters; the Small Block prize mechanism remains unchanged.
The number, recipient, and lifecycle of tickets issued for referral mints remain unchanged despite the revised Big Block prize amount and draw trigger.
The source retains five winners and does not change random ticket-weighted selection, eligible population, or applicable draws.
The source does not change how tickets are allocated when a mint has no referral code.
Separate Big Block and Small Block counters and their reset-after-draw semantics remain valid without modification.
Changing the Big Block prize amount and trigger does not change the existing manual prize-collection mode.
The obligation to publish prize-pool values remains unchanged; this candidate state does not encode the Big Block amount or trigger.
The source does not alter visibility of the two ticket counters or permanent badges in NFT metadata.
The automatic $5 referral commission is independent of the revised Big Block prize parameters.
The source does not disable or otherwise change enforcement of royalties on secondary sales.
The first-referral badge trigger is unrelated to the Big Block prize amount and draw trigger.
The source changes Big Block prize parameters but does not change unauthenticated access to public APIs or their listed data categories.
